notes.title: 番外篇《梦桃花》2024年七夕发布
notes.content:
各位玩家七夕好，《阴桃花》追加了新免费DLC啦！是9000字的番外篇小说，名字叫《梦桃花》哦。

最初策划梦桃花的时候，Snowy想写一个轻松日常的纯甜发糖小文，并将自己的小说idea交付给信赖的网文写手“不系之舟”来实现。然而在创作过程中，Snowy发现自己与不系之舟关于现实与婚恋爱情的观念有不少冲突，创作几起几伏。然而幸运的是，《梦桃花》还是如期定稿，至于这里面有多少是Snowy的理念有多少是不系之舟的想法，有兴趣的玩家可以自行猜测。

需要注意的是，由于Snowy近期暂时没有开发用电脑，无法更新《阴桃花》游戏本体代码，所以本DLC需要各位玩家安装后自行前往游戏根目录找到 Dream Peach Blossom.txt 文件打开阅读，以后Snowy会更新游戏本体在主界面提供DLC阅读引导。

感谢各位大家两年来对《阴桃花》的支持，希望大家能够喜欢这个全新的番外小故事，让我们度过一个爱意满满的七夕，游戏愉快！

notes.title: 未来更新大完美结局预告（含剧透）
notes.content:
今年生病好久，只更新了情人节特典，后面一直没有更新了。现在身体状态应该基本稳定了，可以好好构思这部作品了。
很久以前，在那个只有马车的年代，相爱的两人必须出生在相近的地区，如果分隔两个大洲，那是连邂逅的可能性都不会有的。后来有了书信，相爱的异地恋人等一封信要几个月甚至一两年。而现在，智能手机在哪里都能发消息，异国恋只要调整作息适应时差。
在我发布阴桃花的2022年，梦中的恋人在现实中无法存在，尝试让梦中的恋人成为现实要得精神疾病，或者要知足常乐忍受现实中的孤独。两年过去了，ChatGPT横空出世，AIGC眼花缭乱，周围的一切悄然变化，新的时代已经到来，曾经的遗憾成为历史，坚持弥久的爱情终将突破虚幻的次元，在人世间绽放。

notes.title: 2 and Remake
notes.content:
(Translated by ChatGPT.)

The draft story for "Yin Peach Blossom 2" is already completed, but the understanding of the alpha readers is completely different from my initial creative intention, so I am not planning to proceed with the public release of the sequel for the time being.

Another recent plan is about "Yin Peach Blossom Remake" (temp name), where I plan to add more details, longer text, and scene and character illustrations with voice acting on the basis of the original game. However, there are many tricky parts about the remake version. First of all, if Qian Shui's image is represented in graphics, it might not be as perfect and free as the girl in the dream, and it may not meet the aesthetics of some players (although I actually have a little trick about this, but I'll keep it secret for now); secondly, I can't get in touch with 听眠, the author of "DLC Wind Catching Diary", and I alone do not have enough capacity to handle tens of thousands of words, and finding another suitable person would also require a lot of effort; In addition, I plan to make full use of AI technology, although this may cause Steam to not pass the review, but I can find other channels for distribution, such as itch.io, DLsite, etc.

Furthermore, the theme of "Yin Peach Blossom" is too niche, most people do not have similar experiences, and it is difficult to resonate. Of course, it can also be said that my ability is insufficient, causing the game to not resonate with players (it's not fair to blame the theme). Actually, even for "Yin Peach Blossom 1", I found that many readers' understanding is completely different from my creative intention. Although one can say that there are as many Hamlets as there are readers, I also feel a kind of loneliness of the male protagonist in the game (although my text may not have expressed the loneliness of the protagonist). Therefore, how to further refine and elaborate on this theme, so that the essence of this theme can infect the readers, is a topic I need to study. In this matter, even 听眠 can't help me, she is just proficient in literature, but she also does not have similar experiences. Although she understood Yin Peach Blossom from my narration, "DLC Wind Catching Diary" clearly did not showcase her level. Some things, only I can do, and I hope I can do it.
